title: Browser do Web Page cet Request reak kana ar okate udub kana?
learningObjectives: Browser-re URL em dular khan Web Page screen-re najok kana, ona saral prakriya re mukhya dhap-ko barnan kate thik kram-re sajao dare kana.
URL ren Scheme, Domain Name ar Path lekhan mukhya hissa-ko chinhao dare kana ar Browser do khojok Resource chinhan khatir Address leka babohar kana, ona bujhao dare kana.
Domain Name sange juri Network Address khoj laagi DNS oka leka sahajog kana ar Cache re menak DNS khobor katha-katha abar babohar hoba, ona bujhao dare kana.
Resource Request patha ag Browser do cet leka Network Connection toiri kana, ona barnan kate Website HTTPS babohar khan TLS Connection leka rokkha kana, ona bujhao dare kana.
HTTP Request ke suru star-re barnan dare kana ar Browser do Server ke menak Resource khatir leka janam kana, Method ar Headers ren bhumika chinhao dare kana.
HTTP Response re Status Code, Headers ar darkar khan Response Body ren bhumika bujhao dare kana ar safal Response ar Error Response majhi re mul farak chinhao dare kana.
Page ren gathan bujha khatir Browser leka HTML parhao kana ar Elements leka dekhok kana ona thir khatir CSS leka babohar kana, ona barnan dare kana.
Stylesheets, Images, Fonts ar JavaScript Files leka badti Resources Browser leka khoj kate Request kana ar Scripts Page ren kaj ar acharan re oka bhumika kana, ona bujhao dare kana.
Server khon Data menak ar Page screen re dekhok, ona alag dhap kana bujhao dare kana ar Browser leka Layout hisab kana, Content Paint ar Render kana, ona saral re barnan dare kana.

DNS Lookup Failure, Server Error, Styles ban dekhok ar Resource deri te Load kana leka samasya-ko Request–Rendering Flow babohar kate bujhao dare kana; Cache, Redirects ar ek sathe Request-ko asli kram badal dare kana, ona bujhao dare kana.

understand.concept: Ame Browser re Web address (URL) ol kate Enter dabale, Browser ona Page reak khobor khoj leka. Domain name reak Server address age te bad menak khan, DNS reak sahajog te khoj lekha. Taya te Server saote Network connection banaw kate HTTP Request kul lekha. Server HTTP Response phiraw lekha. Browser HTML parhaw, darkar CSS, Images, Fonts leka Resources anaw, JavaScript calaw ar Page screen re udub kana. Ona ses reak kaj ke Rendering men kana.
understand.whyItMatters: Ona process bojhaw kate Website ban udub reak karon khoj laho kana. URL bhul, DNS ba Network connection re samasya, ba Server Error hoy dare kana. Page khul kana kintu Design ban udub khan CSS ba ar Resource Load ban hoy akana.
understand.history: Web reak suru khon URL do Resource chinaw, HTTP do Request ar Response adan-pradan, ar HTML do Document reak gathan udub. Browser ar Network Protocol arho unnati akana, kintu ona mul dharana do nit Web reak adhar kana.
understand.analogy: Library khon pustak anaw leka bhabna. Age pustak okare menak ta janam, taya te mangaw ar men khan parhaw. Browser o Server khoj, Request kul, Response men ar khobor ke Web Page leka udub kana.
understand.analogyLimit: Asol Web re mit Page lagi mit File khali jothest na. HTML saote CSS, Images, Fonts ar JavaScript leka onek Resources darkar hoy dare kana. Kichu ar Server khon hijuk kana ba Cache re age khon menak. HTTPS re TLS Connection re calak khobor ke nirapad rakaw kana.

explain.narrative: Dhapo: 1. Browser URL parhaw. 2. Domain name reak Server address ban bad menak khan DNS sahajog men. 3. Server saote Network connection banaw; HTTPS khan TLS Secure connection hoy. 4. HTTP Request kul. 5. Server khon Status code, Headers ar darkar leka Body menak HTTP Response men. 6. HTML parhaw, CSS, Images, Fonts anaw ar JavaScript calaw. 7. Page Render kate screen re udub. Ona bojhaw lagi saral dhap kana; asol re Cache, Redirect ar onek Requests ek somoy hoy dare kana.

examples.code: URL → DNS (if needed) → Connection → HTTP Request → HTTP Response → Process resources → Render Page
examples.explanation: Asol Web re mit Page lagi mit File khali jothest na. HTML saote CSS, Images, Fonts ar JavaScript leka onek Resources darkar hoy dare kana. Kichu ar Server khon hijuk kana ba Cache re age khon menak. HTTPS re TLS Connection re calak khobor ke nirapad rakaw kana.
examples.expectedOutput: Browser Page کي process ڪري اسڪرين تي ڏيکاري ٿو۔

practise.guidedTask: Website reak thikana thik kana, kintu Browser re “Server Error” udub kana. Ar obostha re Page khul kana ar Text udub kana, kintu Design ban. Ona donho samasya reak karon alag alag chinaw me.
practise.independentTask: Mit Website khul me. URL emok khon Page udub reak talareya dhap ko nijor katha re serial te ol me. Prottek dhap re Browser, DNS, Network connection ar Server cin kaj kana ta bojhaw me.
hints: DNS do Domain name saote jukto Network address khoj re sahajog kana.
HTTP Request Browser khon Server te calak kana; HTTP Response Server khon phiraw hijuk kana.
Response men khan o Browser HTML ar ar Resources Process kate Page Render daray kana.
Text udub kana kintu Design ban khan CSS Resource Load ban akana mit karon hoy dare kana.

questions.prompt: Sadharan Web visit re DNS reak mukhya kaj cin kana?
options: Domain name saote jukto Network address khoj re sahajog.
Page re rang ar Design jogaw.
questions.answer: Domain name saote jukto Network address khoj re sahajog.
questions.explanation: DNS do Domain name ar ona Network address reak sambandh khoj re sahajog kana.

questions.prompt: HTTP Response re sadharan te cin menak dare kana?
options: Status code, Headers ar Response data.
questions.answer: Status code, Headers ar Response data.
questions.explanation: HTTP Response re Status code ar Headers menak; Body re HTML ba Error reak khobor menak dare kana.
